description: The plot illustrates the loss of various models over the number of iterations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 140000, and has tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays six lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, solid), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue, solid), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid), and SepLLM (n=128) (navy blue, solid). All lines exhibit a decreasing trend in loss as the number of iterations increases, starting from around 3.3-3.4 at 0 iterations and decreasing to around 2.5 at 140000 iterations. The lines for Vanilla, SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) are closely grouped, with loss values ranging from approximately 2.5 to 2.55 at 140000 iterations, while StrmLLM (n=64) has a higher loss of around 2.65 at 140000 iterations, and SepLLM (n=128) has a loss of around 2.6 at 140000 iterations. Each line has a shaded region around it, indicating variability or uncertainty in the loss values.
